lines.en: label mollydorm15:
: Hey, Molly. Are you home right now?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Molly。你现在在家吗？

lines.en: : Is that you, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 是您吗，Sensei？

lines.en: : I’m having a hard time hearing over how much fun I’m having!
lines.zh: : 我玩得太开心了，都听不清您在说什么！

lines.en: : Are you like, masturbating or something?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在……自慰什么的吧？

lines.en: : Even better!
lines.zh: : 比那还棒！

lines.en: : {i}Than masturbating?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}比自慰还棒？{/i}

lines.en: : Why don’t you come on in and take a look?!
lines.zh: : 您为什么不进来亲眼看一看呢？！

lines.en: : I mean...okay, I guess.
lines.zh: : 我是说……好吧，那行吧。

lines.en: : You’re kind of weirding me out, though.
lines.zh: : 不过你有点吓到我了。

lines.en: scene black
{i}Hi, guys! It’s me, Selebus.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}大家好！是我，Selebus。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Before we go into Molly’s room, I just want to let you all know about this awesome game I've been playing called Raid: Shadow Legends.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}在进 Molly 房间之前，我想先跟各位安利一下我最近在玩的一款超棒的游戏，叫 Raid: Shadow Legends。{/i}

lines.en: {i}You see, I’ve never been much of a mobile gamer, but forget EVERYTHING you know about mobile games because Raid: Shadow Legends is the single most ambitious mobile game of the year.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}你看，我以前从来不算什么手游玩家，但请把你对手机游戏的一切认知都忘掉，因为 Raid: Shadow Legends 是今年最有野心的手游。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But I’m sure you’ve heard that a thousand times before, right?{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过这种话你肯定已经听过一千遍了吧？{/i}

lines.en: {i}And that’s probably because with over 300,000 reviews and a nearly five star rating on all app stores, EVERYONE can agree that Raid: Shadow Legends is worth the hype!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那大概是因为，它在所有应用商店里有超过 30 万条评价、评分接近五星，所有人都一致认为 Raid: Shadow Legends 名副其实！{/i}

lines.en: {i}So, without wasting any more of your time talking about Raid: Shadow Legends, I’ll let you get back to the game.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}那么，我就不浪费你们更多时间聊 Raid: Shadow Legends 了，让你们回到游戏里去。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Lessons in Love, I mean. Not Raid: Shadow Legends.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}我是说 Lessons in Love。不是 Raid: Shadow Legends。{/i}

lines.en: {i}But of course, the chances of anyone reading this are slim to none since Raid: Shadow Legends is the most innovative, awesome game of all time.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过话说回来，反正也没什么人会读到这段话，毕竟 Raid: Shadow Legends 是有史以来最具创新、最棒的游戏。{/i}

lines.en: {i}There’s literally no reason to play other games anymore!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}真的再也没有理由去玩别的游戏了！{/i}

lines.en: {i}But I guess if you really want to keep playing Lessons in Love instead of Raid: Shadow Legends, I should let you finish opening the door.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过如果你真的想继续玩 Lessons in Love，而不是 Raid: Shadow Legends，那我还是让你把门开完吧。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Before I go, though-{/i}
lines.zh: {i}不过在我走之前——{/i}

lines.en: {i}Just kidding. I won’t rant anymore.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}开玩笑的。我不唠叨了。{/i}

lines.en: {i}Enjoy Molly’s next dorm event.{/i}
lines.zh: {i}好好享受 Molly 的下一段宿舍事件吧。{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyraid1
I walk into Molly’s room to find her sitting on her chair, absorbed in some game on her phone- the same way she always is.
lines.zh: 我走进 Molly 的房间，发现她坐在椅子上，沉迷于手机上的某个游戏——跟平时一模一样。

lines.en: But something about the air in the room this time makes me feel like she might be playing the most innovative action RPG on mobile platforms, Raid: Shadow Legends.
lines.zh: 但这一次房间里的空气有点不对劲，让我觉得她玩的可能是移动端最具创新性的动作 RPG，Raid: Shadow Legends。

lines.en: : Oh! Hey, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 哦！嗨，Sensei！

lines.en: : As much as I’d love to put the phone down I’m just...kind of in the middle of something here.
lines.zh: : 虽然我很想把手机放下，可我……这会儿正忙着呢。

lines.en: : I can see that. You really look like you’re enjoying yourself right now.
lines.zh: : 看得出来。你现在看起来是真的乐在其中。

lines.en: : Oh, but I am! I’m having more fun than I’ve ever had at any point in my life!
lines.zh: : 哦，那当然！我这辈子从来没有这么开心过！

lines.en: : In fact, I’m questioning whether or not I should keep coming to[school] or if I should just sit at home and play this game until I turn into dust!
lines.zh: : 事实上，我都在犹豫还要不要继续来 [school] 了，还是干脆坐在家里玩这个游戏，一直玩到化成一堆尘土！

lines.en: : What game are you playing, Molly?
lines.zh: : 你在玩什么游戏啊，Molly？

lines.en: scene mollyraid2
: I’m playing Raid: Shadow Legends! It’s only the most unique, action packed game of the last six million years!
lines.zh: : 我在玩 Raid: Shadow Legends！这可是过去六百万年里最独树一帜、最刺激的游戏！

lines.en: : Filled with ultra realistic graphics and detailed character designs, Raid: Shadow Legends looks more like a console game than a game you play on your phone!
lines.zh: : 画面极其逼真，角色设计细致入微，Raid: Shadow Legends 看起来更像主机游戏，而不是你手机上玩的那种游戏！

lines.en: : I was actually thinking that you were playing Raid: Shadow Legends the second I walked in here.
lines.zh: : 其实我一进门就在想，你玩的一定是 Raid: Shadow Legends。

lines.en: : I mean, it’s the only logical explanation for the look of childish excitement and passion in your eyes.
lines.zh: : 我是说，这是唯一能解释你眼里那股孩子气的兴奋和热情的理由。

lines.en: : Sensei! I had no idea you also played Raid: Shadow Legends!
lines.zh: : Sensei！我真不知道您也在玩 Raid: Shadow Legends！

lines.en: : If you’re a new player, make sure you use the code MayaIsANerd to start with 50,000 extra silver!
lines.zh: : 如果您是新手，记得用兑换码 MayaIsANerd，开局就能多拿 50,000 银币！

lines.en: : You’ll also gain access to a special tournament with special in-game prizes!
lines.zh: : 您还能进入一个特别的锦标赛，拿到特别的游戏内奖励！

lines.en: : But hurry up! Because the community behind Raid: Shadow Legends is growing fast and you never know when they’ll make this totally free game pay to win!
lines.zh: : 不过要抓紧！因为 Raid: Shadow Legends 的社区正在飞速壮大，你永远不知道他们什么时候会把这款完全免费的游戏变成氪金取胜！

lines.en: : But Molly-
lines.zh: : 可是 Molly——

lines.en: : Yes, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sensei？

lines.en: : I thought the developers of Raid: Shadow Legends were so confident in their game that they would NEVER resort to something like that.
lines.zh: : 我还以为 Raid: Shadow Legends 的开发组对自家游戏信心十足，永远都不会干出那种事呢。

lines.en: : That’s a good point, Sensei! The drops and rewards you receive from even being a free to play Raid: Shadow Legends member make coming back to the game every day so much more exciting!
lines.zh: : 说得好，Sensei！哪怕只是免费玩家，你在 Raid: Shadow Legends 里拿到的掉落和奖励，都让每天回归游戏变得激动人心！

lines.en: : And with the best graphics in mobile games today, that excitement just keeps growing.
lines.zh: : 再加上当今手游里最出色的画面，这股兴奋只会越来越浓。

lines.en: : I mean, how else would Raid: Shadow Legends have gained over ten million subscribers in the last six months?
lines.zh: : 我是说，不然 Raid: Shadow Legends 怎么会在过去六个月里斩获超过一千万订阅用户呢？

lines.en: : And not only that, but it has over fifteen million downloads in that same exact time frame!
lines.zh: : 还不止这些，它在同一时间段内的下载量超过一千五百万次！

lines.en: : That means half of the users who play Raid: Shadow Legends like it SO much that they delete it just to download it again!
lines.zh: : 这意味着玩 Raid: Shadow Legends 的人里，有一半喜欢它喜欢到会把它删掉再重新下载一遍！

lines.en: : Two copies of Raid: Shadow Legends? Doesn’t that seem a little excessive to you?
lines.zh: : 两份 Raid: Shadow Legends？你不觉得这有点太夸张了吗？

lines.en: : Not at all, Sensei. In fact, before starting Raid: Shadow Legends, I kept hearing a bunch of things about it.
lines.zh: : 一点也不，Sensei。事实上，在开始玩 Raid: Shadow Legends 之前，我就一直听到关于它的各种说法。

lines.en: : So, I decided to throw some hours at it and, I’ve gotta say, it really is just as good as the 300,000 reviews on the app store make it out to be.
lines.zh: : 于是我决定投入点时间试试，我得说，它真的就跟应用商店里那 30 万条评价说的一样好。

lines.en: : In fact, even the app store itself agrees! That’s why Google Play nominated it for an award for being one of its top RPGs!
lines.zh: : 事实上，连应用商店自己都认同！所以 Google Play 才提名它，把它评为顶尖 RPG 之一！

lines.en: : What I like most about Raid: Shadow Legends is that it’s got a really cool story mode, active PVP arenas, dungeons, and sixteen different factions.
lines.zh: : Raid: Shadow Legends 我最喜欢的地方，是它有超酷的剧情模式、活跃的 PVP 竞技场、地下城，还有十六个不同的阵营。

lines.en: : Those are all great features, but what {i}really{/i} makes the game for me is that it has hundreds of heroes for you to collect and customize, with more being released every month!
lines.zh: : 这些都是很棒的特性，但{i}真正{/i}让这款游戏成为神作的，是它有数百位英雄供你收集和培养，而且每个月还在推出新英雄！

lines.en: : Yeah. If I remember correctly, you gain rewards like armor, currency, and characters like Arbiter for just learning how to play the game.
lines.zh: : 嗯。如果我没记错的话，光是学会怎么玩，你就能拿到盔甲、货币，还有 Arbiter 这样的角色作为奖励。

lines.en: : And what better time to learn than now with login rewards every single day for the first 90 days! Have you ever heard of an offer that good?
lines.zh: : 而学习的最佳时机就是现在，前 90 天每天登录都有奖励！你听说过这么好的活动吗？

lines.en: : Wow. Maybe you {i}should{/i} drop out of[school], Molly.
lines.zh: : 哇。也许你{i}真该{/i}从 [school] 退学，Molly。

lines.en: : I mean, it {i}would{/i} give me a lot more time to take part in the new, highly anticipated Faction Wars system.
lines.zh: : 我是说，那样我{i}就{/i}有更多时间参加万众期待的全新 Faction Wars 系统了。

lines.en: : Did you just say FACTION WARS?
lines.zh: : 你刚才说 FACTION WARS？

lines.en: : That’s right! {i}Faction Wars{/i} is an all new game mode that pits faction against faction in a fight for honor and glory.
lines.zh: : 没错！{i}Faction Wars{/i} 是一个全新的游戏模式，让阵营与阵营为了荣耀而战。

lines.en: : It’s up to you, the player, to form a team of champions in order to enter the crypts and take down the powerful demonic leaders inside of them!
lines.zh: : 玩家需要组建一支勇士小队，进入地穴，打倒里面强大的恶魔首领！

lines.en: : The better you perform on each stage will net you huge rewards, with some even being brand new heroes!
lines.zh: : 每一关表现越好，奖励就越丰厚，有些甚至还是全新的英雄！

lines.en: : Holy fuck. You should drop out {i}immediately{/i}.
lines.zh: : 我操。你应该{i}立刻{/i}退学。

lines.en: scene mollyraid3
: You really think so? But what will I do about money?
lines.zh: : 您真这么觉得吗？可钱的事怎么办？

lines.en: : Who needs money when you can succeed even as a free to play player in Raid: Shadow Legends.
lines.zh: : 在 Raid: Shadow Legends 里，就算你是免费玩家也能出人头地，谁还需要钱啊。

lines.en: : All you need to do is log on and you’re already profiting.
lines.zh: : 你只要登录就已经在赚了。

lines.en: : It’s fucking insanity, Molly.
lines.zh: : 这他妈太疯狂了，Molly。

lines.en: scene mollyraid4
: I...I can’t believe it...
lines.zh: : 我……我简直不敢相信……

lines.en: : It’s like...everything I’ve wanted is finally within my reach, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 就好像……我想要的一切终于触手可及了，Sensei。

lines.en: : Will you...drop out with me?
lines.zh: : 您……愿意跟我一起退学吗？

lines.en: : Yes. And do you want to know why?
lines.zh: : 愿意。你想知道为什么吗？

lines.en: : Because in Raid: Shadow Legends, you can join a clan with your friends and everyone’s contributions to clan boss fights add up and help you take down the biggest, baddest enemies in the game?
lines.zh: : 因为在 Raid: Shadow Legends 里，你可以跟朋友一起加入氏族，每个人对氏族首领战的贡献会累积起来，帮你打倒游戏里最大最狠的敌人？

lines.en: : {i}Exactly.{/i}
: But...but what about all of the other girls? I don’t think any of them play Raid: Shadow Legends.
lines.zh: : 可……可是其他那些女生怎么办？我觉得她们没人玩 Raid: Shadow Legends。

lines.en: : FUCK those girls. We don’t need them.
lines.zh: : 去他妈的那些女生。我们不需要她们。

lines.en: : They’re missing out on the most innovative mobile game of the last seventeen millennia.
lines.zh: : 她们错过的是过去一万七千年里最具创新性的手游。

lines.en: : It’s crazy to think that Raid: Shadow Legends has also been clinically tested and is now a proven cure for type 2 diabetes.
lines.zh: : 更疯狂的是，Raid: Shadow Legends 还经过了临床测试，现在已被证实能治愈 2 型糖尿病。

lines.en: : After the first time {i}I{/i} played Raid: Shadow Legends, my penis grew six more inches and I can now hold an erection for two whole hours.
lines.zh: : 第一次玩完 Raid: Shadow Legends 之后，{i}我{/i}的阴茎长了六英寸，现在能勃起整整两个小时。

lines.en: : Can I ask you a question though, Molly?
lines.zh: : 不过我能问你个问题吗，Molly？

lines.en: : Is it about Raid: Shadow Legends or your penis?
lines.zh: : 是关于 Raid: Shadow Legends，还是您的阴茎？

lines.en: : It’s about why you’re crying.
lines.zh: : 是关于你为什么在哭。

lines.en: : Oh. I’ve just never seen graphics this realistic before.
lines.zh: : 哦。我只是从没见过这么逼真的画面。

lines.en: : Sometimes, I forget the heroes aren’t actual tiny people living inside of my phone that leave behind families when they die.
lines.zh: : 有时候我会忘了，那些英雄并不是活在我手机里的真正的小人，死了也不会留下家人。

lines.en: : That may be true, but boy do I have news for you.
lines.zh: : 这也许没错，不过我可有个天大的消息要告诉你。

lines.en: : The next update coming to Raid: Shadow Legends lets you resurrect one person from your {i}real{/i} life as long as you enter the code “HOPE.”
lines.zh: : Raid: Shadow Legends 的下一次更新，只要你输入兑换码「HOPE」，就能复活你{i}现实生活{/i}中的一个人。

lines.en: : I could bring my mom back!
lines.zh: : 那我就能把我妈妈带回来了！

lines.en: : You could. I’ve already decided who {i}I’ll{/i} be resurrecting.
lines.zh: : 你可以。{i}我{/i}已经决定好要复活谁了。

lines.en: : Is it Ami’s mo-
lines.zh: : 是 Ami 的妈——

lines.en: : It’s the person I killed on the way over here for not liking Raid: Shadow Legends.
lines.zh: : 是我来这儿路上杀掉的那个不喜欢 Raid: Shadow Legends 的人。

lines.en: : I don’t want to go to jail.
lines.zh: : 我可不想进监狱。

lines.en: : Because you’re afraid you won’t survive?
lines.zh: : 因为你怕自己活不下来？

lines.en: : No. Because I wouldn’t be able to play Raid: Shadow Legends anymore.
lines.zh: : 不是。因为那样我就再也玩不了 Raid: Shadow Legends 了。

lines.en: : You’re right! That’s even worse!
lines.zh: : 你说得对！那更糟！

lines.en: : But at least Raid: Shadow Legends is easy enough to understand that you’d be able to come back after years of not playing and pick up right where you left off.
lines.zh: : 不过至少 Raid: Shadow Legends 足够好上手，就算你几年没玩，回来也能从上次断掉的地方接着玩。

lines.en: : And with new characters being added every nineteen seconds, there will probably be eighty-seven-trillion by the time your sentence is over.
lines.zh: : 而且每十九秒就有一个新角色加入，等你服完刑，大概已经有八十七万亿个角色了。

lines.en: : I’m going to need more storage space on my phone...
lines.zh: : 那我的手机得需要更大的存储空间……

lines.en: : Just buy more phones! Because, let’s face it, are you even {i}playing{/i} Raid: Shadow Legends if you’re only using {i}one{/i} phone?
lines.zh: : 那就多买几台手机呗！因为，说真的，如果你只用{i}一台{/i}手机，那还算是在{i}玩{/i} Raid: Shadow Legends 吗？

lines.en: : Way ahead of you, Molly. I just ordered nine more so every one of my fingers can be playing a copy of Raid: Shadow Legends at the same time.
lines.zh: : 我早想到了，Molly。我又订了九台，这样我每根手指都能同时玩一份 Raid: Shadow Legends。

lines.en: scene mollyraid5
: Wow! I wish I had that many fingers!
lines.zh: : 哇！我要是有那么多手指就好了！

lines.en: : You {i}do{/i} have that many fingers, Molly.
lines.zh: : 你{i}本来{/i}就有那么多手指啊，Molly。

lines.en: : Oh! Whoops!
lines.zh: : 哦！哎呀！

lines.en: : I guess I’ve just been playing Raid: Shadow Legends for so long that I’ve forgotten basic human concepts like the amount of fingers on a hand or how to make your lungs pump air throughout your body.
lines.zh: : 我想我玩 Raid: Shadow Legends 玩得太久了，连一只手上有几根手指、怎么让肺把空气送到全身这种基本的人类常识都忘了。

lines.en: : But Molly-
lines.zh: : 可是 Molly——

lines.en: : Yes, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Sensei？

lines.en: : Your body is supposed to regulate breathing automatically. You shouldn’t have to focus on manually doing it.
lines.zh: : 呼吸本来是身体自动调节的。你不该需要自己想着去手动呼吸。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well then we should probably call an ambulance because I can’t breathe at all!
lines.zh: : 那我们大概该叫救护车了，因为我完全没法呼吸了！

lines.en: : Hahah! Looks like your body might like Raid: Shadow Legends a little too much as well!
lines.zh: : 哈哈！看来你的身体对 Raid: Shadow Legends 也喜欢得有点过头了！

lines.en: scene mollyraid6
: Hahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahahah!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene mollyraid7
Molly falls backward on her chair due to asphyxiation and loses valuable time playing Raid: Shadow Legends, the most innovative and awesome RPG to ever exist.
lines.zh: Molly 因窒息从椅子上向后倒了下去，白白损失了玩 Raid: Shadow Legends 的宝贵时间，那可是有史以来最具创新、最棒的 RPG。

lines.en: With over nine trillion players (That’s more people than there are on Earth! Even aliens play!) Raid: Shadow Legends truly has something for everyone.
lines.zh: 拥有超过九万亿玩家（比地球上的人还多！连外星人都在玩！），Raid: Shadow Legends 真的对每个人都有吸引力。

lines.en: Play for thirteen hours every day and you’ll even see improvements in the following areas:
lines.zh: 每天玩上十三个小时，你甚至会在以下方面看到改善：

lines.en: Sex life.
lines.zh: 性生活。

lines.en: Ability to talk to old people.
lines.zh: 跟老年人聊天的本事。

lines.en: Appreciation for the color orange.
lines.zh: 对橙色的鉴赏力。

lines.en: Football.
lines.zh: 橄榄球。

lines.en: Handball.
lines.zh: 手球。

lines.en: Other sports involving balls.
lines.zh: 其他用球的运动。

lines.en: Finding sales at grocery stores.
lines.zh: 在杂货店里找到打折商品。

lines.en: Sex Life Pt. II: Return of the Sex.
lines.zh: 性生活 2：性之归来。

lines.en: And even resurrecting Irish transfer students who forgot how to breathe.
lines.zh: 甚至能让忘了怎么呼吸的爱尔兰转学生复活。

lines.en: : Molly! Come back to me!
lines.zh: : Molly！快回到我身边来！

lines.en: scene mollyraid8
: Hello!
lines.zh: : 您好！

lines.en: : Thank you, Sir!
lines.zh: : 谢谢您，老师！

lines.en: : I can now confirm that Heaven does not exist!
lines.zh: : 我现在可以确认天堂根本不存在！

lines.en: : It was nothing but pure darkness!
lines.zh: : 那里只有纯粹的黑暗！

lines.en: : I am scarred for life!
lines.zh: : 我这辈子都要留下心理阴影了！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : Hahahahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: scene black
{i}We now return to your regularly scheduled Molly event...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}现在回到你正常播出的 Molly 事件……{/i}

lines.en: scene mollyraid9
: Oh. Hello, Sir.
lines.zh: : 哦。您好，老师。

lines.en: : It’s nice seeing you for the first time tonight right now.
lines.zh: : 今晚第一次见到您，真高兴。

lines.en: : Yes, neither of us have actually interacted tonight until this very moment.
lines.zh: : 是啊，今晚直到此刻之前，我们俩其实都没说过话。

lines.en: : And anything that took place over the last five minutes never actually happened.
lines.zh: : 而过去五分钟里发生的任何事，其实都从未发生过。

lines.en: : Exactly, Molly MacCormack.
lines.zh: : 正是，Molly MacCormack。

lines.en: : Precisely, Sir.
lines.zh: : 完全正确，老师。

lines.en: : Okay, well that was a fun hang out session.
lines.zh: : 好吧，这趟串门挺开心的。

lines.en: : We should do this again sometime.
lines.zh: : 我们改天应该再来一次。

lines.en: : Yes. Yes we should.
lines.zh: : 好。我们确实应该。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sir.
lines.zh: : 晚安，老师。

lines.en: : Goodnight, Molly.
lines.zh: : 晚安，Molly。

lines.en: scene black
Molly and I only hang out for a few seconds before we decide to split apart for the night.
lines.zh: Molly 和我只待了几秒钟，就决定今晚各自散了。

lines.en: I walk down the stairs, sliding my phone out of my pocket as I do so.
lines.zh: 我走下楼梯，顺手把手机从口袋里掏了出来。

lines.en: And navigate to the app store-
lines.zh: 然后打开应用商店——

lines.en: To download Raid: Shadow Legends! Now available on all mobile platforms!
lines.zh: 去下载 Raid: Shadow Legends！现已在所有移动平台上线！
